The ocean, he decided, could keep the secret a while longer.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市褪去白日的喧嚣，只剩路灯昏黄的光晕洒在空旷的街道上。环卫工人的橙色身影缓缓移动，扫帚声格外清晰。远处偶尔驶过一辆货车，车灯划破夜色，又归于沉寂。二十四小时便利店像一座孤岛，玻璃窗后是打盹的店员和冒着热气的关东煮。早市的摊主开始卸货，塑料筐的碰撞声预示着黎明将至。这座城市在沉睡与苏醒之间，露出最真实的模样。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something is defined by using a smaller version of itself, like a story that starts with 'once upon a time' and contains another whole story inside it.\n- To keep it from going forever, you need a base case — a simple answer you already know, like the smallest Russian doll that doesn't open.\n- You keep asking the smaller question until you reach the base case, then use that answer to work your way back up, one step at a time."}
